subject.title: fix: harden cron and Workboard scheduling under load

question: Should OpenClaw accept the checksum-pinned direct OpenGrep release binary as the canonical security-scanner installation path after verifying its release provenance on the refreshed merge head?
rationale: This PR changes a CI code-execution boundary in two security workflows, and the protected `security` and `maintainer` labels require an explicit maintainer decision rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Verify and retain direct asset
options.body: Confirm the fixed asset URL and SHA-256 against the official v1.25.0 release, attach final-head scan evidence, and merge the workflow approach with the scheduling fixes.

options.title: Keep the installer-based path
options.body: Retain the existing pinned installer design and land the cron and Workboard changes separately if maintainers prefer its provenance model.

options.title: Pause the workflow change
options.body: Split the scanner installation change into a security-focused PR while the broader scheduling repair receives independent review.

recommendation.title: Verify and retain direct asset
recommendation.body: Confirm the fixed asset URL and SHA-256 against the official v1.25.0 release, attach final-head scan evidence, and merge the workflow approach with the scheduling fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation combines the scheduling work with the security workflow design and its supplied validation plan.
